The '''mother''' of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Varner Hilts]] was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Slippery Hilts|man]] of the [[Hilts family]], and with him, she gave [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to Varner in [[3060 BBY]]. Sometime prior to [[3000 BBY]], her husband [[Death/Legends|died]] after an accident in which his [[Shikkar|weapon]] fell from his sheath and stabbed him. Just one [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after his death, the widow planned to seduce the same [[Unidentified faction leader|Sith]] her husband had planned to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] with his shikkar. She sneaked into the Sith's chamber concealed in an urn, but the urn's lid failed to open. Unbeknownst to her, her target was actually out of town for one [[Standard month/Legends|month]], so she died in the urn.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]<ref name="Secrets" /> [[Time/Legends|sometime]] prior to [[3060 BBY]].<ref name="time" /> A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the woman was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]<ref name="Secrets" />&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were stranded on Kesh following the crash-landing of their [[Omen|vessel]] there in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> She [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Slippery Hilts|member]] of the [[Hilts family]], with whom she gave [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to a son, [[Varner Hilts|Varner]], in 3060 BBY.<ref name="Secrets" />

Sometime before [[3000 BBY]], her husband&mdash;who had hoped to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Unidentified faction leader|leader]] of one of the Tribe's [[Beray faction|factions]]&mdash;was [[Death/Legends|killed]] after his [[Shikkar|weapon]] fell from his sheath and lodged in his ankle. However, his death did not much affect her, as just one [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later she attempted to seduce the leader for her own purposes. She concealed herself in a large ceremonial urn and had several underlings deliver her to the Sith's chambers. However, they neglected to inform her that the head of the faction was out of town campaigning and was not to return for a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. Furthermore, the urn's lid refused to open, and she died inside of it,<ref name="Secrets" /> at under the age of sixty.<ref name="time" /> The cleaning [[Slavery/Legends|servants]] were horrified when they finally found her body.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Personality and traits==
The mother of Varner Hilts was very ambitious, much like the rest of the Hilts family. She was not overly distraught by her husband's accident; within a week of his death she even plotted to surprise and seduce the Sith who her husband had hoped to kill.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
Varner Hilts' mother is first mentioned in the eighth [[eBook]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith]]'' series, [[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets|''Secrets'']], written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and released [[March 5]], [[2012]].<ref name="Secrets" />
